name: recharm
description: Turn creative briefs into shot lists and find matching footage in your Recharm library.

interface.longDescription: Recharm turns a creative brief, script, or ad idea into a finished piece of ad creative using footage from your own Recharm clip library. It breaks the brief into scenes, searches your library for clips that fit each scene, reviews the candidates visually, and returns a shareable shot-by-shot brief with clip picks. It can also cut a finished ad video from those picks, with voiceover, music, and captions. Built for marketers, creative strategists, and video editors who produce paid-social and UGC ads. Requires a Recharm account with access to a clip library; it only works with footage in your own library.
defaultPrompt: Find footage for this creative brief.
What footage is missing from my library?
Turn this script into a shot list with clip picks.
